pages.text: Converts a value to a JSON document.$(br2)With $(1)indent$() 0 the document is one line. If $(1)value$() is a single variable with a json tag, the value is placed at the path of the tag. $(1)indent$() outside 0 to 16 raises INVALID_ARGUMENT.
$(li)$(1)value$() any type: the value to convert$(li)$(1)indent$() INTEGER: spaces per level, 0 to 16 (optional, default 0)$(li)result $(1)result$() STRING: the JSON document
$(1)CALL c0de/strings/TO_JSON$(br)  PARAMETER value config ;$(br)  PARAMETER indent 2 ;$(br)  RESULT result json$()
